questions.question: Share R360 between Lerato and Sipho in the ratio 4 : 5. Show your steps and two checks.
questions.expected_answer: Total parts 4 + 5 = 9; one part R360 ÷ 9 = R40; Lerato 4 × R40 = R160, Sipho 5 × R40 = R200. Check: R160 + R200 = R360 and 160 : 200 = 4 : 5.

questions.question: Explain the difference between a ratio and a rate, with an example of each.
questions.expected_answer: A ratio compares quantities of the same kind in the same units and has no unit, e.g. 4 hours : 5 hours = 4 : 5. A rate compares quantities of different kinds and has units, e.g. 240 km in 3 h = 80 km/h.

questions.question: 2 kg of maize meal costs R38 and 5 kg costs R85. Which is the better buy? Show the unit rates.
questions.expected_answer: R38 ÷ 2 = R19 per kg; R85 ÷ 5 = R17 per kg. The 5 kg bag is the better buy because each kilogram is cheaper.
